clips.title: The story
paras: Terenthis is a night elf druid stationed in the coastal settlement of Auberdine. Representing the Cenarion Circle, he is investigating the alarming corruption spreading through Darkshore and Teldrassil. He enlists capable travelers to gauge rising threats along the coast and assist local allies trapped by corrupted wildlife.

Sent to Auberdine by the Cenarion Circle, Terenthis focuses on tracking the spread of Fel Moss and other corruptive forces seeping into Darkshore from Teldrassil. The night elves view this creeping blight with immense concern, fearing the wild balance of northern Kalimdor may fracture completely if left unchecked. Terenthis works to uncover the root causes of the rot and devise ways to halt its advance before it consumes the forests.
